passives.name: Paldea Rush
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by the first time it enters a battle each battle. When used in a co-op battle, reduces the user’s sync move countdown by the first time your team enters a battle each battle instead. The more allied sync pairs with you have on your team, the greater the reduction is. (Each additional sync pair increases the reduction by one, and the maximum reduction is three.) The effects do not stack if you have more than one sync pair on your team with passive skills of the same name.
